# Problem

Describe the problem and link the related issue.
Use a closing reference only when this change satisfies the issue's acceptance criteria.

## Changes

Explain the resulting behavior or documentation and the affected scope.
Identify preserved contracts and any separate follow-up issues.

## Verification

List the exact commands and results for applicable checks.
Distinguish source checks, host execution, and model behavior.
Reuse passing evidence only while its relevant inputs, configuration, and tools remain unchanged.

## Limitations

Record failed or unrun checks, their causes, and any required follow-up owner and action.
State whether any material limitations remain.
